verdict.rationale: AgentMail's own docs describe a first-party hosted MCP server at https://mcp.agentmail.to/mcp that exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, and calendar tools to any compatible client, and a probe confirms the official MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that agents connect and use the server successfully, plus documented connection and authentication setup details in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
